name: Plex
description: Stream your movies, shows and music to every screen.
notes: Your media goes in /srv/media (or change the folder in /opt/plex/docker-compose.yml).
compose:
services:
  plex:
    image: lscr.io/linuxserver/plex:latest
    container_name: plex
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "{PORT}:32400"
    environment:
      PUID: "1000"
      PGID: "1000"
      TZ: "{TZ}"
      VERSION: "docker"
    volumes:
      - {DATA}/config:/config
      - /srv/media:/media
